description: This file implements a 'Noop' (no-operation) custom headers handler that adheres to the CustomHeadersHandler interface, providing a default implementation which simply returns the default headers without modifications.

classes.name: NoopCustomHeadersHandler
classes.description: A singleton class implementing the CustomHeadersHandler interface, providing a default implementation that does not modify headers.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Provides access to the singleton instance of NoopCustomHeadersHandler.

methods.name: handleCustomHeaders
methods.description: Handles custom headers by returning the default headers wrapped in a completed CompletableFuture without modifications.
